findings.claim_text: Tinker's published rates for Inkling 2 Mini are $0.75 per million training tokens at 64K context and $1.50 at 256K
Gwern targets over $1,000 a month per user, notes dynamic evaluation costs more than 3x normal usage, a three-model ensemble more than 6x a frozen model, and warns against optimizing for low cost.
No source I found shows Inkling 2 Mini, or any open model, doing the daily personal learning gwern describes.
